FX.title: [USD/JPY] UP: Bullish Momentum Holds Above MA20 as Fed Commentary Supports USD
tldr_points: USD/JPY trades above its 20-day moving average, signaling short-term bullish momentum.
Fed's Daly comments on a strong jobs report bolster the US dollar's fundamental outlook.
Technical indicators suggest room for further upside with RSI at 56.21, well below overbought levels.
FX.excerpt: USD/JPY holds bullish momentum above MA20. Fed's positive jobs commentary and solid technical support favor further upside.
FX.comment: Bullish momentum is sustained above the 20-day moving average, supported by strong US macro data and favorable yield differentials.
